lead: >-
  Gourmet VIP tours of Chile differ in their actual itineraries: tastings in the Maipo Valley, a private wine day in Millahue, a chef-prepared lunch among Atacama lagoons, or a culinary stop within a long multi-country journey. Some trips include a winery, while on others the tasting is an optional extra or takes place in Argentina instead. Choose according to the location and length of the wine experience, confirmed services and what the price covers.

## Gourmet VIP tours in Chile: what to compare first

Our catalogue includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}}. The selection ranges from short trips in Chile to private multi-country journeys and long expedition itineraries. **They differ not only in price and duration but also in what “gourmet” actually means.** One trip takes you to vineyards and cellars, another features dinner with a chef in a natural setting, and a third may have most of its tastings on the Argentinian portion of the itinerary.

To choose a trip specifically for Chilean wine or cuisine, examine each day's itinerary rather than relying solely on the name or thematic category. The country's wine valleys are concentrated mainly in central Chile, near [Santiago](/chile/place/santiago-de-chile/). Gourmet experiences in [Atacama](/chile/place/san-pedro-de-atacama/) are different: they centre on the landscape, altitude and the dining arrangements during excursions.

For trips without the VIP filter, see [all food and wine tours involving Chile](/interests/food-and-wine/tours/chile/). The [general Chile VIP selection](/vip/chile/) also includes itineraries prioritising nature, history or expedition experiences.

## Comparing confirmed itineraries

| Tour | Wine or culinary focus |
|---|---|
| [VIP: Atacama and Patagonia, 7 days](/chile/tour/chile-vip-atacama-patagonia-gourmet/) | Chef-prepared meals and special dining experiences in Atacama; Maipo is a possible extra |
| [5-star VIP Chile, 10 days](/chile/tour/chile-five-star-vip/) | Chilean wine tasting in the Maipo Valley, plus a journey through Atacama and Patagonia |
| [Best of Brazil, Argentina and Chile, 13 days](/multi-country/tour/best-of-brazil-argentina-chile/) | Final day visiting Maipo vineyards and tasting wines in Chile |
| [Private Grand Tour, 17 days](/multi-country/tour/chile-argentina-private-grand-tour-17-days/) | A wine day in Chile's Millahue and separate wineries around Mendoza, Argentina |
| [Luxury Patagonia, 10 days](/multi-country/tour/luxury-patagonia-10-days/) | Maipo tasting offered as an optional addition to the nature itinerary |
| [Grand South America, 33 days](/multi-country/tour/south-america-luxury-33-days/) | A separate helicopter excursion to VIK winery, including a tasting and lunch |

The [seven-day gourmet VIP tour](/chile/tour/chile-vip-atacama-patagonia-gourmet/) combines Chile's natural regions with distinctive dining experiences. In Atacama, the itinerary includes a gourmet lunch in a high-altitude landscape, cocktails, breakfast near the geysers and special chef-led experiences. The Maipo Valley is mentioned as a possible additional outing if your arrival time allows. **Booking this itinerary does not mean that a winery visit is already an included day.**

The [10-day 5-star VIP Chile itinerary](/chile/tour/chile-five-star-vip/) is better suited to travellers who want to explore a wine region without changing countries. Its day in Santiago includes a trip for [wine tasting in the Maipo Valley](/chile/place/maipo-valley/), followed by Atacama and Chilean Patagonia. Unlike the seven-day itinerary, an introduction to Chilean wine is explicitly part of the main route.

On the [13-day journey through Brazil, Argentina and Chile](/multi-country/tour/best-of-brazil-argentina-chile/), the wine experience is also in Chile: the final day takes place in Santiago and the Maipo Valley, with a tasting included. However, this is primarily a trip to discover three countries, Iguazu Falls, glaciers and Atacama. One day of wine tasting does not turn the entire journey into a specialised wine tour.

## Chile's wine valleys: where you will taste the wines

### Maipo: a classic addition to Santiago

The [Maipo Valley](/chile/place/maipo-valley/) is easy to include in a trip with time in the capital. Visitors explore winegrowing at the foot of the Andes, taste primarily red wines and tour cellars. For a more focused experience, our site lists a separate [Maipo Valley wine excursion](/chile/maipo-valley/maipo-valley-wine-tour/).

Whether that excursion is included always depends on the tour. On the [10-day VIP Chile trip](/chile/tour/chile-five-star-vip/), the tasting is part of the day's plan. On [10-day “Luxury Patagonia”](/multi-country/tour/luxury-patagonia-10-days/), Maipo is offered as an extra at an additional cost. The [18-day cruise tour through Argentina, Chile and Bolivia](/multi-country/tour/argentina-chile-bolivia-cruise-tour-18-days/) likewise lists the wine excursion among optional services. These should not be treated as equivalent when comparing prices.

### Millahue and VIK: a dedicated wine day

The [Millahue Valley](/chile/place/millahue-valley/) and [VIK winery](/chile/place/vik-winery/) offer a more in-depth wine experience, including the estate's history, architecture, vineyards and tastings. The [17-day private Grand Tour](/multi-country/tour/chile-argentina-private-grand-tour-17-days/) includes a day of personalised tastings here. Its description also mentions the Maipo, Colchagua and Casablanca valleys; the particular wineries are arranged in advance. **This is not a promise to visit all four valleys in one day.**

The [33-day private South America itinerary](/multi-country/tour/south-america-luxury-33-days/) includes a separate helicopter visit to VIK. The [VIK excursion programme](/chile/vik-winery/vik-winery-helicopter-tasting-lunch/) features an introduction to the estate, a private tasting and lunch. This experience takes place in Chile, but other gourmet experiences on the long route, such as lunches near monuments in Peru, cannot simply be attributed to its Chilean segment.

### Casablanca and Colchagua: what to confirm before travelling

The [Casablanca Valley](/chile/place/casablanca-valley/) is closer to the Pacific's influence and is known for white wines, particularly Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay. The [Colchagua Valley](/chile/place/colchagua-valley/) is associated with red grape varieties, including Carmenere and Cabernet Sauvignon. This distinction is useful when choosing a tasting, but **mentioning a wine valley geographically does not mean a winery visit is included in the itinerary**.

For example, the [“Sun, Tango, Wine and Atacama” tour](/multi-country/tour/sun-tango-wine-atacama/) passes through Casablanca on the way to Valparaiso and Vina del Mar, but the confirmed description of that day does not include a compulsory tasting at a Chilean winery. It would be a mistake to choose it as a full Chile-specific wine tour without clarifying the programme.

## Chilean wine or Argentine Malbec: an important distinction

Multi-country itineraries often combine Chilean vineyards with the wine regions of [Mendoza](/argentina/place/mendoza/), [Lujan de Cuyo](/argentina/place/lujan-de-cuyo/) and the [Uco Valley](/argentina/place/uco-valley/). These areas are in Argentina. They can enrich a journey, but they do not replace a Chilean tasting if you specifically want to compare Chilean terroirs.

The [17-day Grand Tour](/multi-country/tour/chile-argentina-private-grand-tour-17-days/) includes both a Chilean wine day in Millahue and an Argentinian day visiting three wineries in Lujan de Cuyo. It is a good way to compare two winemaking traditions, provided you remember that the excursions take place in different countries and at different stages of the itinerary.

On the [26-day “Best of Argentina” journey](/multi-country/tour/best-of-argentina-patagonia-26-days/), the wine days are mainly around Cafayate, Mendoza, Lujan de Cuyo and the Uco Valley. The route also visits Chile for Torres del Paine, but its Argentinian tastings cannot be presented as a Chilean wine programme. The same applies to the gourmet day in Buenos Aires on the [18-day cruise itinerary](/multi-country/tour/argentina-chile-bolivia-cruise-tour-18-days/).

For travellers, knowing **which country each tasting actually takes place in and whether it is paid for** matters more than simply seeing a “Food and Wine” interest tag.

## What VIP means when selecting a wine tour

The [Chile VIP selection](/vip/chile/) includes explicitly private itineraries as well as tours with different formats. Inclusion in this catalogue follows the site's existing selection model, including names and price indicators. It is **not a contractual promise of a private guide, helicopter transfer, a particular hotel or a sommelier-led tasting**.

Check three practical questions against the itinerary. First, exactly where does the tasting take place and how much time will you spend there rather than in transit? Second, what does the base price include: the excursion, transport, meals and flights, or only some of these? Third, is the wine experience a substantial part of the trip or an optional addition to a long journey on a single free day? For the helicopter visit to VIK, it is especially important to distinguish the individual excursion module from the total cost of the 33-day journey.

Summer in Chile's wine regions runs from December to February, while the grape harvest generally takes place in late summer and autumn in the Southern Hemisphere. Available tastings, winery opening arrangements, harvest schedules and festivals must be checked for your specific dates. Wineries do not disappear in winter, but the character of a visit and the weather may differ from harvest season.

## Which itinerary should you choose?

If your goal is **Chilean wine combined with several natural regions**, start with the [10-day 5-star VIP Chile itinerary](/chile/tour/chile-five-star-vip/) and the [13-day three-country tour](/multi-country/tour/best-of-brazil-argentina-chile/): both include Maipo in the main itinerary. If **chef-led dining in natural settings** is more important, consider the [seven-day Atacama and Patagonia tour](/chile/tour/chile-vip-atacama-patagonia-gourmet/). For a **private comparison of Chilean and Argentinian wines**, choose the [17-day Grand Tour](/multi-country/tour/chile-argentina-private-grand-tour-17-days/). For a **very long journey with a separate excursion to VIK**, see [33-day South America](/multi-country/tour/south-america-luxury-33-days/).

The [Chile food and wine catalogue](/interests/food-and-wine/tours/chile/) offers a broader selection without the VIP criterion. Consider standalone winery excursions separately from a complete tour: the existence of an excursion page does not mean that experience is already paid for on every route through Santiago.

## Frequently asked questions

### Which VIP tour includes a tasting in the Maipo Valley?

The main itineraries of [10-day 5-star VIP Chile](/chile/tour/chile-five-star-vip/) and the [13-day Brazil–Argentina–Chile trip](/multi-country/tour/best-of-brazil-argentina-chile/) explicitly include a visit to the Maipo vineyards with tasting. On other trips, this may be an optional excursion.

### Is there a gourmet VIP tour without a compulsory winery visit?

Yes. The [seven-day Atacama and Patagonia itinerary](/chile/tour/chile-vip-atacama-patagonia-gourmet/) focuses on chef-prepared lunches, drinks and breakfasts amid natural scenery. A wine valley is mentioned as an extra option rather than a required day.

### Can I combine tastings in Chile and Mendoza?

Yes. The [17-day private Grand Tour](/multi-country/tour/chile-argentina-private-grand-tour-17-days/) includes a wine day in Millahue and a separate day in Argentina's Lujan de Cuyo. Flights and their cost should be checked against the tour's own conditions.

### Do VIP tours guarantee private tastings and five-star hotels?

There is no blanket rule covering the entire catalogue. Private arrangements and personalised tastings are confirmed in each itinerary. For example, the [17-day Grand Tour](/multi-country/tour/chile-argentina-private-grand-tour-17-days/) is advertised as private, while [5-star VIP Chile](/chile/tour/chile-five-star-vip/) specifies accommodation in five-star hotels or similar. These conditions cannot be applied to every tour in the selection.

### Where can I find a winery excursion separately from a long tour?

See the pages for the [Maipo Valley wine excursion](/chile/maipo-valley/maipo-valley-wine-tour/) and [VIK winery tasting with lunch](/chile/vik-winery/vik-winery-tasting-lunch-from-santiago/). Check the conditions of each standalone excursion against its own programme, regardless of whether it also appears on a VIP itinerary.

## North or south: choosing a nature-focused VIP tour of Chile

Our selection includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}}. Tours may share the same country and theme yet offer very different scenery. Northern Chile is home to [Atacama](/chile/place/san-pedro-de-atacama/), salt flats and mountain lagoons. In the south are [Torres del Paine](/chile/place/puerto-natales-torres-del-paine/), glaciers and coastal mountain landscapes.

The distances between these regions are considerable. So **compare not only the number of days but also the time actually spent in each natural area**. An itinerary covering the whole country involves more flights and transfers than a trip focusing on one part of Chile.

We select itineraries for the VIP catalogue according to established criteria. The designation does not guarantee a private guide, five-star accommodation or a dedicated boat on every tour. Such services are specified for each travel product.

## Atacama: minerals, salt and volcanic peaks

Around San Pedro de Atacama, travellers visit [Los Flamencos National Reserve](/chile/place/los-flamencos-national-reserve/), [Chaxa Lagoon](/chile/place/laguna-chaxa/) and the high-altitude lagoons of [Miscanti](/chile/place/laguna-miscanti/) and [Miniques](/chile/place/laguna-miniques/). The colours of the water and mineral deposits stand out against the volcanic ridges.

The [nine-day “Chile's Hidden Treasures” tour](/chile/tour/chile-hidden-secrets-9-days/) combines Atacama, Patagonia and other natural stops. [“5-star VIP Chile”](/chile/tour/chile-five-star-vip/) also links several regions. When choosing between them, check how many days are actually devoted to the north and which lagoons are included rather than judging by an attractive title alone.

The high-altitude desert brings strong sunshine, wind and considerable temperature changes. Visits to the lagoons require suitable clothing, water and preparation for high-altitude areas. If you have a medical condition affected by altitude, discuss any restrictions with your doctor in advance.

## Torres del Paine: granite peaks and lakes

[Torres del Paine](/chile/place/puerto-natales-torres-del-paine/) is among Patagonia's most recognisable natural areas, drawing visitors with granite peaks, open valleys, lakes and glacier views.

The [10-day “Luxury Patagonia” tour](/multi-country/tour/luxury-patagonia-10-days/) combines natural attractions in Chile and Argentina. As this is a multi-country itinerary, not all ten days are spent in Chile. If the park is your main interest, check how much time the itinerary actually devotes to it and which excursions are included.

[Grey Glacier](/chile/place/grey-glacier/) offers an entirely different experience from the dry landscapes of Atacama. Access to viewpoints and boat excursions depends on the itinerary, weather and local rules. Mentioning Patagonia in a tour's title does not guarantee a separate visit to any particular glacier.

## Chilean fjords and Marble Caves

To discover coastal Patagonia, consider [“Patagonia and the Chilean Fjords”](/multi-country/tour/patagonia-chilean-fjords/). This expedition-style itinerary relies heavily on water transport. It differs markedly from a road excursion through the mountains: travellers view slopes and glacial formations from the water.

The [Marble Caves](/chile/place/marble-caves/) stand out for their stone walls and the colour of the water. They feature in the [nine-day “Chile's Hidden Treasures” itinerary](/chile/tour/chile-hidden-secrets-9-days/). Reaching the caves involves a boat trip, however, so how close you can get and how much time you have there depend on actual conditions.

If you want Atacama, glaciers and caves in one journey, allow for flights and overland transfers. For longer walks and photography, a tour visiting fewer regions but spending more time at each attraction can often be more suitable.

## Which natural areas should you compare?

| Goal | Area |
|---|---|
| Salt flats and mineral-rich lakes | Atacama |
| Granite peaks, lakes and mountain walks | Torres del Paine |
| Glacier views | Grey and other glaciers specified in the itinerary |
| Coastal mountains and sea crossings | Chilean fjords |
| Rock formations beside the water | Marble Caves |

Season and weather affect the north and south differently. Compare excursion schedules, physical demands, accommodation and the number of travel days in advance. Ada Tours helps you choose a route according to the places actually visited and agree the services, rather than relying only on the VIP category.

## Frequently asked questions

### Do all nature-focused VIP tours include both Atacama and Patagonia?

No. Some itineraries cover both parts of the country; others concentrate on the north or south.

### Can a visit to the Marble Caves be guaranteed in any weather?

No. The boat excursion depends on local conditions, and the details of the selected itinerary must be confirmed.

### Does VIP guarantee a private guide?

The filter alone provides no such guarantee. Guiding arrangements depend on the particular tour.

### Where can I find more nature itineraries?

Explore the [Chile VIP catalogue](/vip/chile/) and [nature-focused multi-country journeys](/multi-country/interests/nature/) to compare destinations and durations.

## Where to watch wildlife in Chile

**A single journey through Chile can reveal very different natural areas, but sightings of specific animals are never guaranteed.** In the north, the main birdwatching locations are near high-altitude lagoons and salt flats. Guanacos, condors and pumas live in Patagonia, while penguins and marine mammals can be found closer to the Strait of Magellan.

Our VIP selection includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}}. Among them are [“Chile's Hidden Treasures”](/chile/tour/chile-hidden-secrets-9-days/), [“Luxury Patagonia”](/multi-country/tour/luxury-patagonia-10-days/) and [“5-star VIP Chile”](/chile/tour/chile-five-star-vip/). These are different nature itineraries. Being in the VIP collection does not itself guarantee a personal naturalist or a particular hotel category.

## Flamingos and Atacama's high-altitude lagoons

[Los Flamencos National Reserve](/chile/place/los-flamencos-national-reserve/) lies near [San Pedro de Atacama](/chile/place/san-pedro-de-atacama/). Chilean, Andean and James's flamingos can be seen at [Chaxa Lagoon](/chile/place/laguna-chaxa/). [Miscanti Lagoon](/chile/place/laguna-miscanti/) and [Miniques Lagoon](/chile/place/laguna-miniques/) attract visitors with mountain scenery and high-altitude nature.

The [nine-day “Chile's Hidden Treasures” tour](/chile/tour/chile-hidden-secrets-9-days/) includes these places on a dedicated excursion. On the scenic alternative, [“Atacama, Patagonia and Gourmet Experiences”](/chile/tour/chile-vip-atacama-patagonia-gourmet/), flamingos and vicunas are described as possible sightings on a sightseeing route; it has no separate wildlife-watching outing. [“5-star VIP Chile”](/chile/tour/chile-five-star-vip/) combines northern natural areas with Patagonia.

On day 3 of “Hidden Treasures” and day 4 of “5-star VIP Chile”, the itinerary includes a [high-altitude lagoons excursion](/chile/san-pedro-de-atacama/atacama-highland-lagoons-socaire-toconao-full-day/) that explicitly features flamingo watching at Chaxa. Bird sightings depend on the birds' movements, weather and access rules. Within the reserve, follow permitted routes and local guides' instructions.

## Guanacos and condors in Torres del Paine

[Torres del Paine](/chile/place/puerto-natales-torres-del-paine/) is known for more than granite peaks and lakes. Guanacos can be seen on the open steppes; condors, rheas and pumas also inhabit the park. An ordinary sightseeing trip between viewpoints, however, is not a specialist puma-watching safari.

[“Luxury Patagonia”](/multi-country/tour/luxury-patagonia-10-days/) includes a park visit and information about Patagonian wildlife. [“5-star VIP Chile”](/chile/tour/chile-five-star-vip/) and [“Atacama, Patagonia and Gourmet Experiences”](/chile/tour/chile-vip-atacama-patagonia-gourmet/) also lead to [Grey Glacier](/chile/place/grey-glacier/) and the park's lakes. These attractions are primarily landscapes.

## Penguins on Magdalena Island

Boat excursions to Magdalena and Marta islands depart from [Punta Arenas](/chile/place/punta-arenas/). The [10-day “Luxury Patagonia” itinerary](/multi-country/tour/luxury-patagonia-10-days/) includes a boat trip to the islands and observation of Magellanic penguins on Magdalena.

According to CONAF rules, visitors may use designated trails on Magdalena Island without approaching nests or disturbing the birds. Tourists are not allowed to land on Marta Island; it is viewed from the water. The visiting season and sea conditions affect excursion availability. If penguins are your main goal, choose an itinerary with a dedicated boat day rather than merely a stop in Punta Arenas.

## Scenic alternative: the Chilean fjords

The [nine-day “Patagonia and Chilean Fjords” expedition](/multi-country/tour/patagonia-chilean-fjords/) travels through channels and natural areas in southern Chile, including waters near [Laguna San Rafael National Park](/chile/place/laguna-san-rafael-national-park/). Whales, dolphins, birds and sea lions may be encountered along the way. The itinerary does not specify a separate, dedicated marine-wildlife observation excursion. Possible encounters add to the glacial scenery; the cruise itself is not part of the current wildlife-watching selection.

An expedition vessel allows substantial time on the water, but the route, landings and visibility of animals depend on the weather. By contrast, [“Chile's Hidden Treasures”](/chile/tour/chile-hidden-secrets-9-days/) focuses on the [Marble Caves](/chile/place/marble-caves/), lakes and [San Rafael Glacier](/chile/place/san-rafael-glacier/). Travellers choose it for landscapes rather than dedicated marine-mammal watching.

## Included wildlife watching and scenic alternatives

| Main goal | Tour |
|---|---|
| Atacama flamingos | [Chile's Hidden Treasures](/chile/tour/chile-hidden-secrets-9-days/) |
| Northern Chile and Patagonia | [5-star VIP Chile](/chile/tour/chile-five-star-vip/) |
| Magdalena penguins and Marta sea lions | [Luxury Patagonia](/multi-country/tour/luxury-patagonia-10-days/) |
| Scenic alternative: fjords | [Chilean Fjords](/multi-country/tour/patagonia-chilean-fjords/) |
| Scenic alternative: Patagonia and Uyuni | [Three-country tour](/multi-country/tour/patagonia-uyuni-salt-flats-12-days/) |
| Wildlife of the Peruvian Amazon and Ballestas Islands | [33-day VIP tour](/multi-country/tour/south-america-luxury-33-days/) |

On multi-country trips, distinguish wildlife experiences in Chile from those in neighbouring countries. For example, whale watching on the Valdes Peninsula in [“VIP Chile and Argentina”](/multi-country/tour/chile-argentina-vip/) takes place in Argentina. On [“Antarctica Express”](/multi-country/tour/antarctica-patagonia-express-air-cruise-6-days/), Punta Arenas is a transport point, while the main expedition wildlife experiences are in Antarctica. The total length of a journey is not the same as the number of days spent wildlife watching in Chile.

## Seasons, park rules and preparation

Penguin excursions depend on the season, navigation conditions and rules protecting the islands. Strong winds in Patagonia can alter plans for a boat trip. Access to Atacama's high-altitude areas depends on road and weather conditions. Before choosing a route, check included entrance tickets, guiding, transport, dates and park regulations.

**For wildlife watching, several substantial stops in suitable places are more useful than a long list of natural attractions without time to observe them.** Stay on marked paths, do not feed wild animals and do not approach them for photographs.

## Frequently asked questions

### Where can I see flamingos?

On itineraries visiting [Chaxa Lagoon](/chile/place/laguna-chaxa/) and nearby areas of Atacama. Such stops feature, for example, on [“Chile's Hidden Treasures”](/chile/tour/chile-hidden-secrets-9-days/). The exact number of birds cannot be predicted.

### Do tours guarantee a puma sighting?

No. Pumas live in Torres del Paine, but a standard sightseeing excursion is not a specialist search for the predator. A sighting remains a matter of chance.

### Which tour includes a boat trip to penguins?

[“Luxury Patagonia”](/multi-country/tour/luxury-patagonia-10-days/) includes a boat excursion to Magdalena Island. It depends on the season and weather.

### Can I see whales in the Chilean fjords?

Possible encounters during the [scenic Chilean fjords expedition](/multi-country/tour/patagonia-chilean-fjords/) complement the glacier cruise. The itinerary does not include a dedicated whale-watching outing.

### How do nature-focused VIP tours differ from adventure tours?

Nature-focused trips often feature protected areas, walks and wildlife watching without demanding hikes. [Adventure VIP tours in Chile](/vip/chile/interests/adventure/) can also be compared according to physical demands and high-altitude sections.

For glaciers, fjords and mountains, see [Chile's nature-focused VIP tours](/vip/chile/interests/nature/). Other routes with included wildlife observation appear in the [Chile wildlife tour catalogue](/interests/wildlife/tours/chile/) and the [Chile travel guide](/chile/).

lead: >-
  When choosing a VIP trip to Colombia, balance sightseeing days, transfers and time by the sea. Our selection includes a ten-day route through Bogota, the coffee region, Cartagena and Baru Island. It combines private transfers, named hotels and guided excursions, but domestic flights cost extra. Below, we explain the confirmed conditions of this trip and how to select a programme that suits your interests.
---

## VIP tours in Colombia: what is currently available

**For a first premium trip to Colombia, it makes sense to combine the capital, the Andes and the Caribbean coast while allowing time to rest between busy days.** Our catalogue includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}}. The main itinerary in this selection is [“VIP Colombia: Bogota, Coffee Region, Cartagena and Baru Island”](/colombia/tour/colombia-vip-coffee-cartagena-baru-10-days/): 10 days, 9 nights and 4 distinct regions of the country.

This is a real itinerary with a specific set of services. The VIP section title does not mean that every possible option includes a private plane, a personal guide around the clock or the same room category everywhere. This programme confirms private transfers with a driver, the named hotels and guided excursions in particular cities. Flights between regions are not on the base list of included services.

It is more useful to compare **the number of transfers, style of accommodation and distribution of days** than to focus on the word “luxury” alone. The [Colombia travel guide](/colombia/) covers the country as a whole, the [general tour catalogue](/colombia/tour/) offers a wider choice of routes, and this page focuses specifically on the VIP selection and how these trips are organised.

## How the 10 days are divided: cities, coffee and an island

The current route introduces travellers to different parts of Colombia in sequence. Each region offers different experiences and presents its own logistical requirements.

| Stage | Itinerary |
|---|---|
| [Bogota](/colombia/place/bogota/) | 3 nights; museums, Monserrate, Guatavita, Zipaquira |
| [Pereira](/colombia/place/pereira/) | 1 night; [Cocora Valley](/colombia/place/cocora-valley/), Salento, coffee |
| [Cartagena](/colombia/place/cartagena/) | 2 nights; historic city and fortress |
| [Baru Island](/colombia/place/baru-island/) | 3 nights; relaxation by the Caribbean Sea |

The opening days focus on Bogota: the Gold Museum, the Botero Museum, historic streets, [Lake Guatavita](/colombia/place/lake-guatavita/) and Zipaquira's Salt Cathedral. Allow for the capital's altitude, city traffic and excursions beyond its boundaries.

The coffee region is allotted just 1 night. The visit includes Cocora Valley, Salento and [El Ocaso coffee farm](/colombia/place/el-ocaso-coffee-farm/). A hot-air balloon flight is planned for the following morning, followed by a flight to Cartagena. This schedule works well for travellers seeking a memorable introduction to coffee culture. Visiting several farms and examining production in depth would require more time in the region.

Cartagena provides historic architecture and a lively coastal city atmosphere. A speedboat then takes travellers to Baru. Three nights on the island allow the trip to end peacefully, without changing hotels or setting out for early excursions every day. For specific interests, explore the [cultural VIP selection](/vip/colombia/interests/culture-and-history/) or [VIP tours with beach relaxation](/vip/colombia/interests/beach-holidays/).

## Which hotels and services are actually specified?

**The ten-day itinerary names specific hotels.** In Bogota it lists Four Seasons Casa Medina, in Pereira Visus Hotel Boutique & Spa, in Cartagena Sofitel Legend Santa Clara, and on Baru Island Las Islas. The island stay is described as accommodation in a bungalow with a private pool. Room categories, availability for your dates and any equivalent substitutions are established when arranging the trip.

Confirmed transport includes private road transfers with a driver according to the itinerary and the Cartagena–Baru–Cartagena speedboat. Private guided excursions with a Russian-speaking guide are included in Bogota and Pereira; Cartagena excursions use an English-speaking guide. Breakfasts, listed admission tickets and the hot-air balloon flight are included.

**Paid for separately:** international air tickets, Bogota–Pereira and Pereira–Cartagena flights, most lunches and dinners, tips and personal expenses. Do not assume every journey or meal is paid for merely because the tour is labelled VIP. The [tour page itself](/colombia/tour/colombia-vip-coffee-cartagena-baru-10-days/) does not list a fixed starting price; the price depends on the agreed proposal and its contents.

When comparing two options, request the same parameters: dates, number of travellers, room categories, guiding languages and which flights and transfers are included. This makes the substantive differences clear.

## Choosing the focus of your VIP trip

The route via Bogota, Pereira, Cartagena and Baru can serve as a ready-made starting point. Changing the number of days or replacing a region, however, affects logistics and included services. First decide why you want to visit Colombia.

**History and urban culture.** If architecture, museums and walks are your priorities, take a closer look at [Bogota](/colombia/place/bogota/) and [Cartagena](/colombia/place/cartagena/). They already take up a substantial part of the itinerary. More museum time or additional city activities need to be agreed as changes to the route. You can compare the cultural focus in the [Colombia history VIP tour selection](/vip/colombia/interests/culture-and-history/).

**Coffee and Andean nature.** The schedule includes [El Ocaso farm](/colombia/place/el-ocaso-coffee-farm/), an introduction to coffee growing and processing, and Cocora Valley with its wax palms. If several farms, tastings and rural areas matter to you, start with [Colombia coffee VIP tours](/vip/colombia/interests/coffee-tours/) and [gourmet programmes](/interests/food-and-wine/tours/colombia/). A day focused on coffee does not automatically turn the ten-day trip into a specialist gastronomic tour.

**Caribbean coast.** On this itinerary, the stay on [Baru](/colombia/place/baru-island/) begins after the sightseeing days in Cartagena. If you want extra days by the sea, arrange them together with the accommodation and speedboat logistics. The [Colombia beach VIP selection](/vip/colombia/interests/beach-holidays/) is useful for comparing formats.

**Nature watching.** The coffee-growing mountains and Caribbean Sea offer natural scenery, but this is not an expedition into the most remote national parks. For a different balance between cities and nature, explore [Colombia's nature-focused VIP tours](/vip/colombia/interests/wildlife/) and check the activities planned for each day.

## When to travel and the actual logistics

Colombia does not have one weather pattern across the whole country. [Bogota](/colombia/place/bogota/) lies high in the Andes, where it is considerably cooler than on the Caribbean coast. The coffee valleys experience wet and rainy days, while Cartagena and Baru are hot and humid. Pack clothes for different temperatures rather than relying on a single national weather forecast.

Mountain rain can affect a walk in Cocora Valley and a hot-air balloon flight. Flight schedules and aviation operations must be checked for your dates. Avoid scheduling too many additional excursions on a flight day: the itinerary already links several regions, and transfers take time even with private transport.

For families with children, travellers with lots of luggage or those who prefer late starts, it is especially important to consider early departures and activity levels in advance. Private transfers make overland logistics easier to manage, but do not override domestic flight timetables, weather restrictions or museum visiting hours.

If the ready-made trip generally suits you, the easiest starting point is the [ten-day Colombia tour](/colombia/tour/colombia-vip-coffee-cartagena-baru-10-days/), whose itinerary and included services are already described. ## Adventure VIP tours involving Colombia: finding the right itinerary

Adventure travel covers different activities: extended treks, river journeys, nature expeditions and mountain walks. Yet a long list of countries does not itself confirm a demanding sporting itinerary.

Our VIP selection includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}}. On a multi-country tour, **the theme applies to the itinerary as a whole**. Adventure days might be in Chile, Bolivia, Peru or another country, while the Colombian stage is mainly cultural. To choose well, distinguish the full geographical route from the activities actually taking place in Colombia.

## What happens in Colombia on a long itinerary

The [32-day Journey Through Eight South American Countries](/multi-country/tour/south-america-eight-countries-32-days/) covers several climate zones and mountainous parts of the continent. The full programme includes long drives, domestic flights and excursions in different countries. Travellers need to be prepared for altitude changes and a busy schedule.

In Colombia, the group visits Medellin, [Guatape](/colombia/place/guatape/), [Cartagena](/colombia/place/cartagena/), [Bogota](/colombia/place/bogota/) and Zipaquira. A separate day is devoted to El Penol and the reservoir near Guatape. The itinerary then continues with city sightseeing and flights.

**The Colombian stage does not include a multi-day jungle trek.** Do not select it expecting a hypothetical climb that is absent from the day-by-day description. The 32-day journey also has specific departure dates, so availability of a new departure should be checked against the current programme.

## Confirmed VIP services and physical demands

The 32-day journey includes accommodation in four-star hotels, domestic flights, transfers with a driver and guides on excursions listed among the included services. Some excursions are group activities; others are private. This matters when comparing comfort levels.

For contrast, consider the [ten-day VIP Colombia itinerary](/colombia/tour/colombia-vip-coffee-cartagena-baru-10-days/). It includes confirmed canopy activities, a horseback ride and a hot-air balloon flight over the coffee region, but much of the itinerary is also devoted to museums, cities, a farm and relaxation on [Baru](/colombia/place/baru-island/). Active episodes do not turn the entire journey into a demanding expedition.

The VIP label does not guarantee a private aircraft, personal instructor or private transport on every stage. Compare only explicitly specified services, restrictions and payment terms.

## If you want a genuine trek in Colombia

Other types of itineraries are available for travellers who want to spend several days walking through forest. The [Lost City trek](/colombia/tour/santa-marta-lost-city-2023/) in the Santa Marta area leads through humid forests, rivers, settlements and mountain camps. Stamina and a willingness to accept simple accommodation matter here, because the trek itself is the trip's main purpose.

The [eight-day Cano Cristales tour](/colombia/tour/colombia-cano-cristales-8-days/) offers a different format: walks to sections of the colourful river, canoe trips along the Guayabero, off-road vehicles and accommodation in a nature lodge. The published conditions explicitly mention walks of up to 8–13 kilometres and several hours on trails.

**These two itineraries are included here to compare physical demands; their inclusion in the VIP catalogue must be checked separately.** If trekking is your priority, begin with [all adventure tours in Colombia](/interests/adventure/tours/colombia/) and select the right programme. Then compare possibilities for private guiding and accommodation standards.

## How to compare adventure journeys

| Question | What to check |
|---|---|
| Where does the active day take place? | On multi-country tours, the adventure may be outside Colombia |
| How many hours does the walk take? | A sightseeing stroll and a multi-day trek require different preparation |
| What transport is used? | Flights, boats, transfers and off-road vehicles have different conditions |
| What services are included? | Guides, accommodation, meals and optional activities |
| Are there date restrictions? | Some expeditions depend on park access and weather |

In the Andes, altitude and temperature change; forest areas may bring heavy rain, humidity and slippery trails. Before a serious trek, assess your health, fitness, footwear and the rules of the protected area. On a busy multi-country itinerary, days for recovery after transfers are particularly important.

If you want to combine sightseeing with moderate activity, the [general Colombia VIP catalogue](/vip/colombia/) is a useful starting point. If physical exertion is your priority, rely on the detailed trekking programme, even if that tour does not belong to the VIP selection.

### Does VIP necessarily mean a sporting trek?

No. VIP itineraries differ in difficulty; physical demands are determined by the day-by-day activities.

### Which countries might host the adventures on a long tour?

Different countries along the main route. Colombia being included does not mean that every activity on the 32-day journey takes place within its borders.

See the [Lost City trip](/colombia/tour/santa-marta-lost-city-2023/) and the [general adventure catalogue](/interests/adventure/tours/colombia/), checking the actual walking distances.

Yes. For example, the [ten-day VIP Colombia trip](/colombia/tour/colombia-vip-coffee-cartagena-baru-10-days/) combines an active day in the coffee region with cities and beach relaxation.

Transport, guiding language and format, dates, hotels, included meals and particular sporting activities. All depend on the tour selected.
